WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.bats AS bats
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
),
counts AS (
  SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT bats,
       cnt,
       cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SUM(cnt) OVER () * 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()) AS count_vs_avg_per_hand
FROM counts;
